subject: ClearPath AI: implementation orchestration — org setup & API key handoff
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: ClearPath onboarding — org setup, admin invites, API key flow (kickoff)

Hi Elena —

Great to be working with ClearPath on the initial rollout. Summarizing the recommended kickoff plan so engineering can provision access in one pass: 

1) Admin invites: please confirm the primary org admin email to seed (we recommend 1–2 admins).
2) Project namespace + roles: we'll create a top-level project for the pilot and three default roles (Admin, Developer, ReadOnly).
3) API key seeding: we will pre-create two API keys (one long-lived service key for server-side usage, one short-lived for CI) and mark the service key for rotation after 30 days.
4) SSO / SAML: if you want SSO now we can attach SAML metadata into the private deployment; otherwise we'll use email invites for initial users.
5) Security docs: attaching a short SOC2 summary and your onboarding playbook link.

Kickoff options: Wed 12/2 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 12/3 14:00–15:00 PT. Which works for you?

Deliverables by EOD of kickoff meeting: provisioned org, admin invites sent, two API keys issued to your vault, and a shared checklist for role mappings.

Attachments: clearpath_org_structure.xlsx (your org chart), vendor-soc2-summary.pdf

Ask: please reply with the primary admin email and whether you want SSO enabled in this initial wave.

Thanks — looking forward to the run.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: ClearPath onboarding — org setup, admin invites, API key flow (kickoff)

Hi Elena — welcome, and thanks for confirming the admin. Short answers below, followed by the setup checklist I'll own with Marcus.

QA: Recommended TTL for CI key — 8 hours to 24 hours depending on CI cadence; 12 hours is a reasonable default for pipelines that run nightly. For service-to-service (server) workloads we issue a long-lived service key (~90 days) and enforce rotation after 30 days for the first cycle.

Vault integration: yes — we can either: 
- Push the generated keys to your Vault via the Vault API (requires a service user token we can exchange), or
- Provide keys directly and you import them into Vault (manual).

What we'll do on our side during kickoff (owner assignments):
- Sean: org creation, top-level project and role templates, RBAC mappings.
- Marcus: API key seeding, Vault push option, and initial key rotation policy.
- Monica: admin invites, onboarding checklist, and docs handoff.

Prep items for ClearPath prior to kickoff:
- Confirm who should receive the initial two keys (list emails you want keys associated with).
- Provide a short-lived Vault token with write scope to the target path if you want automated push (we'll delete the token after onboarding).
- Jira project link or ticket for mapping role-to-permission expectations (helps speed mapping).

Attaching SOC2 summary as requested.

See you Wed 12/2 10:00 PT — I'll send a calendar invite.

Subject: Re: ClearPath onboarding — org setup, admin invites, API key flow (kickoff)

Elena / team —

I'll take point on the API key work during the kickoff. Quick checklist of what I'll need during the session: 
- A Jira ticket (or shared Google Doc) that lists service owners and which role each should map to.
- If you want the automated Vault push: a short-lived Vault token with write permissions to the target path (we recommend a token that expires in 48–72 hours). Please send the token to marcus@redwoodinference.com over Signal or via your secure channel (do not send tokens over plain email).
- SAML metadata (only if you decide to enable SSO later) — XML file or IdP metadata URL.

Plan during the meeting: I will create the project namespace, seed two keys, demo the rotation step, and if you opt in we will push the keys to Vault. I'll also show the RBAC role assignment flow so your admins can verify permissions immediately.
